issues.description: Method name for the operation that feeds all animals is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement (and the solution) specify a Farm method named feedAllAnimals() that "calls messageOnFeed() on all animals". The template's example usage in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (commented code) calls farm.feed() instead. This naming mismatch can confuse students about which method to implement (they may implement feed() or miss implementing feedAllAnimals()), and may lead to compilation or grading mismatches between student code and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example code and the Farm API consistent. Preferred: update src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java in the template to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(). Alternatively, add a small delegating method in Farm (e.g. public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); }) to preserve the template example while keeping the canonical API name.
